I could not identify which facility "A" is. The searches turned up two data centres in Vösendorf: a Microsoft site and an eww ITandTEL site. I've used Microsoft's Vösendorf site as the best guess, but confidence is low, so please confirm the operator or name of "A".

**Year:** Microsoft's Austrian cloud region, with one of its three sites in Vösendorf, was reported as ready for use in 2026.

citations.cited_text: Mit August ist es nun so weit, Microsoft hat seine hauseigene Cloud-Region Österreich bezugsfertig und bietet sie Kunden und Microsoft-Partnern an, au...
citations.title: Microsoft eröffnet Rechenzentrum

content.text: Microsoft has its own Austrian cloud region ready for operation and offers it to customers across three separate sites in Schwechat, Vösendorf and near Mödling.
A regional report dates the opening event to 30 June 2026, though I could not confirm that date from the snippet I retrieved. Microsoft has not confirmed the Vösendorf location officially;

citations.cited_text: Der Konzern selbst bestätigt den Standort offiziell nicht, das sei aus Sicherheitsgründen so üblich.
